proposals.text:
Thanks — I’ll open the formal rewards investigation now for the two EcoCard transactions:
- txn_d398545ca1a2 — Tentree — $200.00 — short by 400 points
- txn_f093f96e2001 — Thrive Market — $175.00 — short by 700 points

What I will do now
- Create the investigation case and have our rewards team review the transaction records, merchant categorization, and applicable reward rates for those purchases.
- If the review confirms an error, we will update the transaction records and apply the corrected points to your EcoCard account using our internal update process (we use the update_transaction_rewards_3847 tool as part of that correction flow).
- I will add notes to the case and keep you updated on status.

Answers to your questions
1) Timeline: Our knowledge base does not include a guaranteed SLA for rewards investigations, so I cannot give a precise guaranteed turnaround from the KB. I will flag this as a priority for review and provide status updates; if you’d like, I can also request expedited review and/or transfer you to a human specialist for faster handling.
2) Will the points post automatically?: Yes — if the investigation confirms the missing points, we will apply the corrected points on your behalf (you don’t need to take any action). We will notify you when the points have been posted and the updated points balance is reflected on your EcoCard account.

Next steps for you
- I’m proceeding now. Do you prefer updates via email (sparkle_queen_99@yahoo.com) or by phone (312-555-0481)? Confirm your preferred contact method and whether you want me to request expedited review.
- If there are any other transactions you want included in this investigation, tell me now and I’ll add them to the case.

Shall I proceed using the email on file for updates and request standard (default) review, or do you want expedited handling?
